cases.result: doctor CLI dispatch did not create workspace

filesystem_verification.mock_boundary: run_doctor was stubbed to isolate and exercise the real gah_ops.main -> _run_doctor_cli -> capacity_profile CLI path; filesystem snapshots were measured around actual capacity_profile execution.

finding.cause: tools/gah_ops.py doctor CLI called capacity_profile(profile, workspace=...), which created .ga/operations/capacity and wrote a profile JSON inside the inspected workspace. That contradicted the bootstrap doctor read-only contract.
finding.change: Doctor now calls capacity_profile(profile) without a workspace. The fixed profile/ref and estimated bounds remain available in memory; bound_verified remains false. Setup apply/profile persistence is unchanged.
finding.existing_test_expectation: The existing tests/test_operations.py mock was updated to expect capacity_profile("sample-ci") without a workspace argument.

limits: Docker was not started; this validates read-only filesystem behavior of the doctor CLI capacity-profile path, not actual host/Docker probes.
The capacity profile remains an estimate; bound_verified stays false and UNKNOWN capacity gating is unchanged.
No setup apply or capacity-profile evidence persistence behavior was altered.
